title: Create your account
subtitle: Free trial, no credit card. Takes about 2 minutes.

email.label: Work email
email.invalid: That doesn't look like an email address. Check for typos.

password.label: Password
password.help: Use at least 8 characters. A short phrase is easier to remember and stronger than symbols. Pasting is fine.

consent: By creating an account you agree to our <terms>Terms of Service</terms> and <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

verify.title: Check your email
verify.body: We sent a 6-digit code to <email/>. Enter it below, or open the link in that email on this device and we'll sign you in.
verify.spam: Nothing yet? Check spam, or you may already have an account.

errors.generic: We couldn't create your account. Please try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
errors.network: Connection problem. Check your internet and try again.
errors.codeExpired: This code has expired. Send a new one below.
errors.codeWrong: That code isn't right. Try again.
errors.verifyFailed: Something went wrong verifying that code.
errors.resendFailed: Couldn't resend the code. Try again shortly.
errors.googleFailed: Google sign-up didn't work. Please use email and password.
errors.appleFailed: Apple sign-up didn't work. Please use email and password.
errors.oauthFailed: Sign-up didn't complete. Please try again.
